**Local DID provisioning (Professional plan)**

- Professional plan supports up to 3 local DID numbers.
- For Hong Kong (+852) local numbers, PSTN interconnection completes within 1 business day after submission.
- After activation, the DID can be bound directly into existing IVR flows via the CINNOX IVR orchestrator — no downtime for existing voice routing.
- Applies to Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, Japan, UK, US local numbers; other regions 1–3 business days.
